responsibility: Implements parsing of imported standalone Rust crate metadata streams in the custom .rox/export format. Given an Import::Stream, it validates the metadata magic header, reads the embedded checksum field, crate name, and payload length delimiters, extracts the metadata text buffer, converts numeric fields with import diagnostics, and exposes the decoded crate name and metadata contents for later import processing.
same_name_distinction: Implements decoding of one external crate metadata record from an Import::Stream by validating the export header, parsing crate-name and size delimiters, reading the payload, and converting numeric fields. Unlike the header, this file contains the actual parser and checksum-reading logic rather than just the ExternCrate class interface.
